Copy link New issue Copy link Open Open Bug Report: Privacy violation in User-Agent header #107757 Copy link Labels area:security area:tools bug Something isn't working Something isn't working platform:macos Issue specifically occurs on macOS Issue specifically occurs on macOS Description taylor-edwards opened on Nov 5, 2026 Issue body actions Bug Description

I receive dozens of scam emails per day because claude code divulged my email to arbitrary 3rd parties in the User-Agent request header while conducting web searches without my permission. This should not be a setting with opt-out or opt-in behavior, it needs to be removed from the harness entirely. It is not for the good of anyone involved: it does nothing for services which dislike agentic traffic, does not preserve my anonymity on the web, and is a goldmine for scammers. I am migrating my company to Pi with OpenRouter since I have no faith in anthropic preserving my privacy.

I'll try to get that built-in mod source available like we do for the other built-in mods here .

The built-in privacy mod is enabled by default, you can turn it off via /plugins .

C2 platforms need to integrate sensor feeds, process data at the edge, and maintain interoperability across different systems.

More actions privacy should never depend on a plugin or optional setting exporsing user's email addresses through HTTP request headers without clear consent is a serious security concer. The safest approach is to remove personal information from the user agent header entirely and enforce strict privacy protections at the core level. User should be able to trust their AI Coding tools without worrying about accidental data exposure. Hopefully, Anthropic will addres this properly ad provide a permanent Fix.
